Thank you for using VRoid Studio.

We’re thrilled to announce the official release of VRoid Studio’s new dress-up feature as well as the XWear format, which have been in development since last year.

A heartfelt thank you to everyone who participated in the closed and open beta tests and provided invaluable feedback.

▼Download VRoid Studio v2.0.0
https://vroid.com/en/studio

■ What are the dress-up feature and the XWear format?
The dress-up feature and the XWear format are new additions to the 3D character creation tool VRoid Studio. 

Now you'll be able to dress up 3D characters, including avatars and outfits designed for VRChat, those created within VRoid Studio, and models in VRM format.

The goal is to provide a broader range of outfit options for all avatars.

1. Fitting feature
This feature allows you to easily adjust the clothing to fit models with varying body types.

In addition to the auto-fitting feature, which quickly adjusts clothing automatically, other tools are available for more detailed manual adjustments.

 Auto-fitting: Automatically adjusts an outfit to suit the model’s body type.
 Bone adjustment: Move, scale, and rotate bones.
 You can reversibly edit the mesh of your model.
 You can create animation without leaving the editing page.

[previewyoutube=6LF5VC-Z3PQ;full][/previewyoutube]

2. Export for VRChat
You can export dressed-up models in a VRChat-compatible format.

This feature also supports converting VRoid Studio models and VRM models for use in VRChat.

3. Export as VRM
Dressed-up models can be exported in VRM1.0 format. 
This makes them usable across various VRM-compatible applications.

This feature can also convert VRChat models into VRM format.

[previewyoutube=z3BHzunNdfU;full][動画2：画面分割でVRChatで動いている様子+VRMで動いている様子][/previewyoutube]

4. Editor extension "XWear Package"
The XWear format and dress-up feature include not only the functionalities provided in VRoid Studio but also additional tools offered as a Unity Editor extension.

This Xwear Package editor extension allows you to convert avatars, costumes, and accessories set up for VRChat into formats compatible with the XWear format and dress-up feature.
Models can be converted into the XAvatar format for avatars or the XWear format for costumes and accessories.

Additionally, when uploading models to VRChat, the XWear Package is used to import dressed-up models into VCC.

notes.title: Dress-up Feature Open Beta Now Live!
notes.content:
Thank you for using VRoid.

We are excited to announce the launch of the open beta for a new feature under development in VRoid Studio, designed to easily dress avatars made from scratch, such as those intended for VRChat, with 3D costumes.

After running a closed beta since December last year, we are now opening the beta to everyone. You can access it for free on both Windows and macOS through Steam’s beta features.

We hope you’ll take this opportunity to try this new feature in VRoid Studio.


■ Dress up your favorite models made from scratch

On BOOTH, pixiv’s comprehensive creative marketplace, you can find a wide range of 3D items for VRoid Studio and outfits intended for VRChat.

However, until now, VRoid Studio could not be used to dress up models other than those in .vroid file format.

With the new VRoid Studio features available in the open beta, you can convert made-from-scratch costume data into a proprietary format, enabling outfit changes on made-from-scratch models.

Additionally, the feature includes export options that allow you to use your created models on external platforms like VRChat or to export them as VRM files.

[previewyoutube=hZheqLChosc;full][/previewyoutube]


Feature details:
[olist]
 Convert model data through Unity editor extensions
You can convert avatar data and costume data intended for VRChat into a proprietary format for use in VRoid Studio.

 Import proprietary format data and  VRM files
You can load data in a proprietary format (XAvatar) or VRM files into VRoid Studio.
You can also add and edit costume and accessory data (XWear) for these avatars or VRM files.

 Fitting features
You can comfortably fit costumes to models with different body shapes.


 An Auto-fitting feature that fits costumes to the model’s body shape with one click
 Move, scale, and rotate by bone
 Temporarily hide parts of the base mesh
 Play animations directly from the editing screen

 Export for VRChat and as VRM files
You can export the dressed-up models either as data for VRChat or as VRM files.
[/olist]

notes.content:

Thank you for always using VRoid.

Come to VRoid Hub, from Friday, July 26th, to Saturday, August 31st, 2024 for the third round of our 3D-Model Posting Project "Costume Challenge"!

The theme for this round of the Costume Challenge event series is "Summer Fashion".
Whether it's playing at the beach or in the pool, or watching fireworks at festivals, summer brings endless memorable moments. With watermelon, ice cream, and shaved ice in abundance, this is the summer everyone's been waiting for! We're excited to see your unforgettable summer fashion designs!

Post to be one of 30 lucky winners selected by lottery to receive an Amazon gift card!

For more details


What's a Costume Challenge?
VRoid Hub sponsors fashion design contests where you can post 3D models wearing original outfits, designed/styled by you. 

Summer is all about swimsuits, yukatas, summer delicacies, and sometimes bugs too! For the summer this year, why not create a summer outfit for your avatar, or design a new original 3D character showing off summer fashion items and styles? We're waiting to see everyone's new designs.

You can use any type of modeling software, paint software, or clothing design tools you like to create your 3D model. So long as your model is VRM format and can be uploaded to VRoid Hub, it's fine if you didn't design your model using VRoid Studio. You can also enter 3D models that you built from scratch.

For this contest, you can of course use original 3D models and fashion items, as well as items you commissioned or purchased, or you can use your favorite avatar you already use as a model.


How to participate
①Dress up your model according to the summer theme
② Save your dressed-up model in VRM format, and upload the model to VRoid Hub
③Add the hashtag #CC_Summer, and publish your model data

notes.title: The 3D Character Maker VRoid Studio is Now Available on iPad!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39361157/93e074d64114a58e2f7222f4ae4098f55ef383d3.png

Thank you for using VRoid.
pixiv Inc. (hereafter referred to as “pixiv”, Office: Shibuya, Tokyo; Representative Director: Shingo Kunieda) is pleased to announce that, as of today, September 7th, 2023, we are launching the VRoid Studio iPad app.

VRoid Studio is a modeling software that allows anyone to easily create their own 3D characters.
In addition to Windows and macOS, VRoid Studio is now also available on the iPad.
The VRoid team hopes that both Windows and macOS users, as well as those who have never used VRoid Studio, will take advantage of this opportunity to experience the joy of 3D modeling with the iPad version.

▼ Download VRoid Studio for iPad here
https://apps.apple.com/us/app/vroid-studio/id6449727674


■ About VRoid Studio for iPad
With the release of the iPad version of VRoid Studio, users can combine the tablet's unique touch controls with stylus pens such as the Apple Pencil. This makes 3D modeling more similar to drawing pictures and thus easier to use.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39361157/bde94bbc65e49a0bf1042821fe3105a7b85aad6e.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39361157/f2f27aebaa2ba6bde26ed8063cd2e4c2e991d335.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39361157/5eac83bfa81c3ed4e09b326a7881fe67934af90d.png

1. Use touch controls
In addition to touch controls in the basic editing panel, VRoid for iPad also supports:

 Undo/redo via tap during model editing
 Pinch in/out, camera rotation, and panning during model editing and shooting

2. Double tap with Apple Pencil
By double-tapping the pen shaft, users can switch between the Pen tool and the Eraser, providing a smoother editing experience.

3. Available for free

Like the Windows and macOS versions, VRoid Studio for iPad is also available for free.


4. Data migration of existing models
If you already have models in the Windows or macOS version of VRoid Studio, you can transfer them between devices using .vroid files.


■ Recommended devices for VRoid Studio for iPad
The following are the recommended devices for running VRoid Studio for iPad. 
If you're using an iPad model not on this list, the initial Texture Display Resolution setting will differ from the default value. (For more details, please refer to "About Texture Display Resolution".)

▼ Recommended iPad models
iPad Pro 12.9" (6th generation)
iPad Pro 11" (4th generation)
iPad (10th generation)
iPad Air (5th generation)
iPad (9th generation)
iPad mini (6th generation)
iPad Pro 12.9" (5th generation)
iPad Pro 11" (3rd generation)
iPad Air (4th generation)

iPad Pro 11" (2nd generation)
iPad Air (3rd generation)
iPad mini (5th generation)
iPad Pro 12.9" (3rd generation)
iPad Pro 11" (1st generation)

▼How to check your iPad model 
On your iPad, open Settings > General > About > Model Name.

About Texture Display Resolution
Texture resolution refers to the quality of the images (textures) applied to the surface of 3D models, and it is associated with the surface's detailed appearance and coloration.
The Texture Display Resolution setting is designed to run VRoid Studio on devices with limited memory. 
On recommended devices, the Texture Display Resolution will be set to the default size. On non-recommended devices, it will be automatically set to half its usual value. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39361157/71f8909ad80d28a596b553f2251b7a44942472e0.png

To access the settings, tap on the "•••" menu located at the top-right corner of the model selection screen. From the menu that appears, you can go to Settings to check or modify the Texture Display Resolution. 

Please note that if you use a non-recommended device with the default texture resolution settings, the application may force quit. 


■ Windows Ink support
As part of this app development update, we have added Windows Ink to the VRoid Studio input system. This enables touch operation with a tablet device in addition to mouse and pen tablet operation. 
Users who use a pen tablet in the Windows and macOS versions of VRoid Studio should read about the following changes:

Settings
(1) Configuration via the settings app that comes with the pen tablet
(2) Start Button > Settings > Bluetooth and Devices > Pen and Windows Ink
(3) Start Button > Control Panel > Pen and Touch

Right-click & right-drag with a pen

 Right-click and right-drag response has improved
 Right-dragging is now possible while hovering

Pressure sensitivity

 The frequency of pressure detection remains the same, but in low frame rate environments (e.g., high CPU loads), the pressure may not be reflected properly. If pressure is not reflected, please check the CPU usage and other system resources.
 Pressure detection latency (the time between the operation and its reflection on the screen) may feel slightly higher than before.

We've created a new Help page with additional information about Windows Ink. If you have any questions or concerns, please visit the link below.

▼Help article for Windows Ink

 When I right-click with my mouse, nothing happens
 A ripple-like effect is displayed around the cursor when I use my pen tablet
 Brush pressure is not detected on my pen tablet
 When I keep pressing the pen point while using a pen tablet, the system interprets it as a right-click


We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and adjustments required for users who have long used a tablet with previous versions. We appreciate your understanding as these changes are required for future app development.

With the VRoid Project, we wish to help create a world where anyone can have their own avatar and fully express themselves through it.
We hope that this release of VRoid Studio for iPad will support many more creative endeavors. We can't wait to see your next creations!

notes.title: FAQ
notes.content:
A huge thank you to everyone using the official release of VRoid Studio!

We're handling bug reports and inquiries in the order they come.
We're expanding our FAQ, but we'll also answer particularly common inquiries here to help clarify things quickly.


"Is there a dark mode?"

 Dark mode is currently under development. There is already an option to darken your background color, so feel free to change it in your settings.


"How do I change the program's language to English?"

 You can do so via the Settings. We also added a fix in 1.0.1 that set VRoid Studio's language to English if your OS language was in English. If it doesn't change, please do so manually.


"Can I export the Guidelines on item textures to edit in other image editing software?"

 You can! Right-clicking each item's layer (on Windows) or Cmd + Clicking (on Mac) will open a menu. Select Export Guide, determine your save location, and it's as easy as that.


"Can I still download the Beta version of VRoid Studio?"

 You can get the beta versions here!
 https://vroid.com/en/studio/releases


"I get an error when converting my model data, and I can't open it."

 You can only convert data from beta version 0.14.0. Models made on earlier versions will first need to be opened and saved in 0.14.0 before you can convert them for use in the stable release.


"Why is my model's skin is disappearing under their tops/dresses?"

 Skin masks erase a portion of your model's skin. Open the Skin Mask tab in the Texture Editor and make the parts you want visible white in the UV Editing Mode. For more info:
https://vroid.pixiv.help/hc/ja/articles/4405516267033


"Can I change clothing and accessory parameters while in the Texture Editor?"

 You can. Select the slider mark in the left-hand panel next to the name of the item you want to adjust, and the parameters will display on the right-hand panel.


"When I select hair presets on a model that's been converted, the old hair disappears."

 The converted hair doesn't disappear; selecting new hair preset simply changes what's displayed. You can restore and save the converted hair via the Custom tab in Overall Hair.


This concludes our FAQ tweets! Visit our dedicated FAQ page for more info:
https://vroid.pixiv.help/hc/en-us/categories/900000339606

Please contact us here for bug reports and inquiries.
https://www.pixiv.net/support?mode=select_vroid

Thank you for using VRoid Studio!

notes.title: ＼Big News ②／ The infographic “VRoid by the numbers” is now public!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=EwUelRkVHAs;full][/previewyoutube]
Most people might be aware of the increasing demand for virtual content, such as the growing hype around VTubers. This was already a trend, but it was made even stronger by the pandemic.

The VRoid Project has been growing too, overcoming not only geographical distances, but language barriers too. Today, we wish to present some of that data.
This is the first time for us at the VRoid Project to publish this kind of data, so we hope you'll appreciate it.

Without further ado, let's take a look at some of the numbers!

▼Read more
https://vroid.com/en/news/3rmZO2zqNGU20UpNV7O1rQ



VRoid by the numbers: VRoid and the global avatar scene!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39361157/e184cbcc89ab450e616a4c8919850a9d0678f44c.png

The VRoid Project made its first public appearance back in 2018, with the release of the first beta version of VRoid Studio, a 3D character maker software, and VRoid Hub, a platform for the community to share their creations. With the smartphone app VRoid Mobile following the year later, VRoid confirmed its presence as multiplatform, and in both English and Japanese.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39361157/1976bd9d0e8ffec6c633d88db1332c238630649e.png

Today, 3 years after launch, about 90% of the community is international. A fact that we very much take pride in. This data really has us appreciate how our community is enjoying 3D creations and the latest 3D trends regardless of language and region.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39361157/95a4497d418e60436e958c2c3891d633878a875e.png

Among all our products, VRoid Studio is definitely experiencing the bigger growth, with the Japanese community doubling and the international one tripling over the last two years.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39361157/5fdf68863163a00a6a8b99fc11850816974423ab.png

We are proud to see that our VRoid Studio is receiving so much love from the whole world. 



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39361157/4e1b71e32b3b83df36f8ccfc1ab586b465885526.png

We're amazed to see that our community has created over 1 million avatars! You could also say that VRoid Hub is a city itself with a population this high!



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39361157/9723c8161f5f31eeb3bfe28be85617af8f5fafb8.png

While there are infinite activities one could involve avatars into, snapping selfies surely is the most appealing, and easy to share with the community. VRoid Mobile is helping people take over 200k pictures per month by providing users with the ability to customize their avatars, providing new backdrops, adding filters, and much more!

How did you find our infographic VRoid by the numbers: VRoid and the global avatar scene? Did any of the data surprise you?

Please let us know what you think of this data, and any other questions/comments you might have, on Twitter (#VRoid) and via our inquiry form. (Don't forget to subscribe to our newsletter!)

notes.title: Your VRoid models, now in Animaze!
notes.content:
Animaze is a software that lets you completely become a 2D/3D avatar through the camera on your PC, mobile phone, etc.
Now you can import models made with VRoid Studio and VRoid mobile into Animaze as VRM files!
(You can also import .vrm files made with other applications as well.)

Learn how to import your models here:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1364390/view/3038219232658195708

Things to note:
When importing .vrm files created on apps other than VRoid Studio or VRoid Mobile to Animaze, please note that they must comply with VRM format standards.

If you have any issues with Animaze or receive an error when importing a .vrm file, please inquire with Animaze's customer support ( support@animaze.us ).

Additionally, if you're contacting Animaze's customer support regarding an error, please attach the following information:


 Application event log (for Animaze or Animaze Editor)
 The .vrm file you were using
 Details of your issue with shading, physics, animation, etc (if possible)
 The expected display/performance of the shading, physics, animation, etc of your model in screenshot or video format when your issue is solved (if possible)
 A screenshot or video of the issue occurring (if possible)

notes.title: Updates to Our FAQ and How to Contact Us
notes.content:
Thank you very much for using VRoid Studio!
We're very grateful that our software has a growing base of users!

We've made some changes to how users can contact us, as well as to our FAQ.

If you have any difficulty understanding how to use VRoid Studio, check out our FAQ to see if it answers any of your questions.
https://vroid.pixiv.help/hc/en-us/categories/360000053442

You can also take a look at the discussion threads in our Community Hub to see if someone has already answered your question - or asked it! 
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1486350/discussions

If you find any bugs or receive an error message, please contact us using this form.
https://www.pixiv.net/support.php?mode=inquiry&type=41&service=vroid-studio&ref=faq

If you do need to use our contact form, including the following information is incredibly helpful for our team:
- the error message you received
- a screenshot or screencap video of the error or bug as it's occurring

Lastly, to keep our community pleasant for everyone, we ask that you always stay mindful and courteous in our forums.

Thank you very much for using VRoid!
